verses.text: Suppose a prophet or someone who has prophetic dreams comes among you and gives you a sign or a wonder.
The sign or wonder they told you about comes true, and they say, “Let’s follow other gods,” gods you’ve never known, “and serve them.”
Don’t listen to that prophet or dreamer. Yahweh your God is testing you to see if you love him with your whole heart and your whole soul.
Follow Yahweh your God and honor him with reverence. Keep his commands, listen to his voice, serve him, and hold on to him.

That prophet or dreamer must be put to death for urging rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of Egypt and freed you from slavery. They tried to pull you off the path Yahweh your God told you to walk. That’s how you’ll remove the evil from among you.

Suppose your brother, your own mother’s son, or your son, daughter, the wife you hold close, or a friend as dear as your own life whispers to you, “Let’s go serve other gods,” gods neither you nor your ancestors have known.
They may be gods of the peoples around you, close by or far away, anywhere from one end of the earth to the other.
Don’t go along with that person or listen to them. Don’t pity them, spare them, or hide what they’ve done.
You must put that person to death. Your hand must be the first against them, followed by the hands of all the people.
Stone them to death because they tried to pull you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of slavery.
All Israel will hear about it and be afraid to do anything that wicked among you again.
Suppose you hear a report about one of the towns Yahweh your God is giving you to live in.
You hear that some wicked people from among you have led the people of their town astray, saying, “Let’s go serve other gods,” gods you’ve never known.
Investigate it, ask questions, and check carefully. If the report is true and you know for sure that something this detestable happened among you,
put the people of that town to the sword. Destroy the town completely, along with everything in it, and put its livestock to the sword too.
Pile up everything taken from it in the middle of the street. Burn the town and everything taken from it for Yahweh your God. It must stay a heap of ruins forever and never be rebuilt.
Keep nothing that was marked for destruction. Then Yahweh will turn from his fierce anger, show you mercy and compassion, and grow your numbers, just as he swore to your ancestors.
He’ll do this when you listen to Yahweh your God, keep all the commands I’m giving you today, and do what’s right in his eyes.
